ios.desc:
In the hustle of modern life, our minds are constantly bombarded with information, making it a challenge to keep track of everything. HiccupAI aims to serve as your private personal memory(not chatbot!), extending your brain's capabilities through AI.
It's an app where you can safely store thoughts, ideas, reminders, and reflections without the fear of forgetting. Imagine being able to communicate with snapshots of your past selves, accessing a time capsule of your thoughts and experiences.

**How Does It Work?**
This is not just another chatbot or chat assistant. You can enter your notes through the input on the homepage, or you can use the speech-to-text feature just next to the input area to take notes. You need to fill in some items to create your personality before you can interact with your AI experience.
We use a credit-based billing system; upon registering, every user receives 50 free credits to explore the app's capabilities. There's the option to purchase additional credits as needed—no subscriptions or hidden commitments. Credits are only spent when you interact with AI; you can enter unlimited notes without incurring any cost.

**Privacy is not Optional**
Your privacy is paramount. We ensure that all user data remains stored on your device, never on our servers. 

**Join Us on This Journey**
HiccupAI is in its formative stage, and we invite you to participate in shaping its future. Privacy-focused, versatile, and user-centric. We aspire to become an ecosystem for nurturing your digital twin. Support us, and let's embark on this journey together to explore the vast potential of our minds with HiccupAI at our side.

quotes.text:
Hi HN!

We're two indie developers excited to introduce you to Hiccup. Often, we found ourselves tangled in our own everyday problems and set out to solve them, leading to the birth of this app.

Hiccup is a simple mobile application; core functionalities allow you to jot down notes, set silent reminders, and dump any and all thoughts that are crowding your mind. It uses language models to sift through your notes, extracting answers and forging connections between them. Think of it as having a personal AI memory that understands the chaos of your thoughts, akin to a 'Shazam for your brain'.

A cornerstone of our philosophy is privacy and user trust. To that end, Hiccup operates with a strict policy: Your notes are yours alone. We have no interest in storing them on our servers, tracking your app activity, or incorporating any intrusive features that we ourselves wouldn't want to use.

It's still early days for us, but we're eager to share Hiccup with a wider audience like you.
App currently only available in the App Store for iOS devices :>

https://apps.apple.com/en/app/hiccup-ai/id6474674651

Thanks!
